census.population: Usual residents (Census 2021: ONS TS001; NISRA MS-A01)
census.households: Households (Census 2021: ONS TS045; NISRA HH_CAR_VAN_TC5, sum of its six categories)
census.noCarHouseholds: Households with no cars or vans available (Census 2021: ONS TS045; NISRA HH_CAR_VAN_TC5 category 0)
census.note: Census counts for small areas are perturbed for confidentiality and need not add up to council totals.

centroids.definition: Census 2021 population-weighted centroid (ONS LSOA V4; NISRA Data Zones), WGS84; straight-line distances are measured from these points

urbanRural.classification: ONS 2021 Rural Urban Classification of LSOAs (England and Wales)

ppfi.index: Priority Places for Food Index v2.1
ppfi.orientation: Rank 1 and decile 1 = highest priority. The publisher's documentation (HASP data dictionary, CDRC pages, IJPDS article; checked 25 Oct 2026) does not state the direction; the data shows it: the socio-economic barriers domain ranks with IoD 2025 and NIMDM 2017, where 1 = most deprived
